rows.text: maps `ecx` to an index `i`: `ecx`-0x1000 when `ecx`-0x1000 is at most 0x1A4 (unsigned), else `ecx`-0x3E5C when `ecx`-0x4000 is at most 0x18, else `ecx`-0x2E44 when `ecx`-0x3000 is at most 0x51, else 0; then tests byte `i`+0xB2E of qword `0209AC30` against 1 shifted left by byte `rdx+0x60` and returns in `al` 1 when that bit is set, 0 otherwise
